subject: Next steps: contract path & payment options (PO vs card) — checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dumas <claire.dumas@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: contract path & payment options (PO vs card) — checklist

Hi Claire — great conversation this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement path: 

1) Commercial path options (pick one):
   - Purchase Order (PO) + Net30 billing (recommended for enterprise finance)
   - Corporate card (immediate start, no PO)
   - Cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace) — we can list or route via marketplace for consolidated billing if your procurement prefers that flow

2) Required procurement artifacts from Redwood (what I'll send):
   - Redlined SOW + pricing summary (attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf; Commercial_Terms_Summary.xlsx)
   - SOC 2 and security overview (link in HubSpot)
   - Standard MSA and data processing addendum (if needed)

3) What we need from Acme to scope the path:
   - Confirmation of preferred payment instrument (PO number or card)
   - Estimated start month and expected monthly committed spend (ballpark is fine)
   - Any internal legal/contract review owner + timeline (name and email)

Suggested next steps:
- If you want PO: please share your standard PO process owner and a sample PO timeline (I can align Redwood billing ops).
- If card: confirm cardholder and we’ll enable trial access same day.
- If marketplace: I can introduce our partner ops to your procurement and work through marketplace terms.

I’m copying Marissa (customer success) and Ben (contracts) so they can jump in on timelines. If useful, I propose a 20-minute sync Thursday 07/23 to align legal and billing owners. Does 10:30am PT work for you?

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0162
Redwood Inference — make inference predictable and economical

[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Commercial_Terms_Summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alex Tremblay <alex.tremblay@acme-retail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Dumas <claire.dumas@acme-retail.com>, Procurement Team <procure@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: contract path & payment options (PO vs card) — checklist

Thanks Soojin — useful summary. A few clarifications from procurements' side: 

- Acme typically prefers PO + Net30 for anything above $5k/mo but we can do a corporate card for pilots under $2k.
- Marketplace is attractive if Redwood can provide consolidated monthly invoices and support consumption metering to our finance system.
- Legal will want to review the MSA and DPA; the legal owner is Claire (cc'd) and our procurement SME is procure@acme-retail.com.

Two quick asks: can you confirm whether Redwood requires an exhibit for data residency if we keep data in multi-tenant hosted region? Also, please confirm if there's a minimum commitment or if month-to-month is available for the first 90 days.

We can do the 20-minute sync on Thursday at 10:30am PT — Alex will host.

Best,
Alex

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: contract path & payment options (PO vs card) — checklist

Alex / Claire / team — thanks for the quick responses. Short answers inline and agenda for Thursday's 10:30am PT sync: 

- Data residency: Redwood can offer region-level controls and a DPA exhibit for EU/US residency requirements; for Acme we can confirm hosted West US region and include the exhibit in the SOW. (Ben — please flag anything special for our legal template.)
- Minimum commitment: for pilots we can do month-to-month up to 90 days with no minimum; for committed reserved capacity we offer 3/6/12 month terms with scaled discounts — details in the attached pricing summary.

Proposed 10:30am PT sync agenda (20 minutes):
1) Confirm commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) — Claire
2) Legal owners and expected review timeline — Claire / Acme legal
3) Billing ops: PO workflow and sample PO format (procure@acme-retail.com) — Soojin/Billing Ops
4) Next steps / owners / target go-live month

If helpful, I've attached the redlined SOW + a one-page commercial summary. If you confirm "PO" before the call, please send an estimated PO issuance date so Marissa and I can lock the onboarding window.

See you Thursday — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: pre-call checklist for Acme sync

Soojin / Ben — quick internal note after syncing with customer calendar invite: 

- Claire confirmed she will push internal legal to review within 5 business days but said procurement may still need a sample PO to route.
- Action items for us:
  * Ben: prepare a short data-residency exhibit and flag any non-standard clauses in the SOW by EOD Monday 07/27.
  * Soojin: add marketplace brief (1-page) to the drive and include in the call deck.
  * Marissa: prepare onboarding timeline for a PO-start vs card-start scenario (expected lead times + first-week tasks).

If legal pushes for a commitment-length discount, confirm if we can offer a 3-month pilot at a 10% discount (I'll own the CS side of that ask).

Thanks — Marissa
